gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.215: A strong brew leaves toxin in the body. Past half a load the world turns green and your pulse slows; past three quarters it starts to hurt.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.216: Sit still by a lit campfire, or soak in a hot spring, and the toxin leaves your body faster. Milk and a golden apple help too.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.217: A toxin gauge, held or worn in the charm slot, shows your load, your tolerance and the next line you will cross.
